versions.subject: Triple Cross Rules
versions.detection:
selection:
  Image|endswith: '/sudo'
  CommandLine|contains|all:
    - ' tc '
    - ' enp0s3 '
  CommandLine|contains:
    - ' qdisc '
    - ' filter '
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="*/sudo" CommandLine="* tc *" CommandLine="* enp0s3 *" CommandLine IN ("* qdisc *", "* filter *")
